results.title: Python 3.14.0 release
results.content: Python 3.14.0 is the newest major release of the Python programming language, released in October 2025. It follows Python 3.13 and Python 3.12.

results.title: Status of Python versions
results.content: Python 3.14 is the latest stable feature release. Python 3.13 and Python 3.12 receive bugfix or security updates; Python 3.11 is in security-fixes-only mode.

results.title: React v19 - React blog
results.content: React v19 is now available on npm as the new stable major version, bringing Actions, new hooks and Server Components support.

results.title: Node.js previous releases
results.content: Node.js 18 has reached end-of-life and no longer receives security updates. As of late 2025, Node.js 24 is the Active LTS line and Node.js 22 is in Maintenance LTS.

results.title: AI Act enters into force - European Commission
results.content: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) entered into force on 1 August 2024, with obligations phasing in over the following years.

results.title: GitHub Copilot plans and pricing
results.content: GitHub Copilot Pro (formerly Copilot Individual) costs $10 per month or $100 per year for individual developers; a limited free tier is also available.

results.title: Spotify Premium price increase (US)
results.content: Spotify raised the price of Premium Individual in the US to $11.99 per month in mid-2024, with Duo and Family plans also increasing.

results.title: Netflix raises US prices
results.content: In the US, the Netflix Standard plan now costs $17.99 per month after the January 2025 price increase; the Standard with ads plan costs $7.99.

results.title: ChatGPT Plus - OpenAI
results.content: ChatGPT Plus costs $20 per month and includes access to OpenAI's latest models, higher usage limits and advanced features.

results.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 - MeitY
results.content: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 was passed by Parliament and received assent in August 2023, establishing India's framework for processing digital personal data.

results.title: Twitter is now X
results.content: Twitter was renamed X in July 2023 as part of Elon Musk's plan to turn the social network into an 'everything app'.

results.title: Satya Nadella - Chairman and CEO, Microsoft
results.content: Satya Nadella is Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Microsoft. He became CEO in 2014.
